# Top Power BI and Microsoft Fabric consultants in Newcastle

Assuming you mean **Newcastle, NSW, Australia**, I’d shortlist consultants based on their ability to deliver more than dashboards: reliable operational reporting, automated data pipelines, governed data models and a scalable data warehouse using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.

There isn’t a reliable independent ranking of the “best” Newcastle consultants, so the following is a practical shortlist based on publicly described services, local presence and relevance to your requirements.

Agile Insights is headquartered in Sydney and delivers across NSW and other Australian states. [www.agile-insights.com.au](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** A larger Fabric implementation involving a modern warehouse or lakehouse, multiple data sources, governance and business-critical reporting.

## 5\. Professional Advantage

(Best for structured enterprise delivery)

Professional Advantage offers Microsoft Fabric consulting and Power BI services, with Microsoft-certified Fabric analytics and data engineering specialists. Its approach includes data consolidation, consistent reporting definitions and phased implementation. [www.pa.com.au](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-fabric/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Organisations needing a structured delivery programme, Microsoft ecosystem integration and a platform that can grow beyond initial reporting requirements.

[Microsoft Fabric services](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-fabric/)

## Which consultant fits your requirements best?

| Your main requirement | My first choice | Why |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Operational reporting and KPI dashboards | **Roar Data** | Specifically targets Newcastle and Hunter businesses |
| Data warehouse and systems integration | **Data Inseyets** | Describes ETL, Azure warehousing and operational data integration |
| Enterprise-scale Microsoft Fabric | **Agile Insights** | Specialist Fabric architecture and engineering capabilities |
| Larger, structured transformation programme | **Professional Advantage** | Certified specialists and phased delivery approach |
| Local advisory and business systems work | **PKF Digital** | Newcastle office and broader technology capabilities |


These are recommendations based on published service descriptions, not verified comparative project outcomes. I would confirm recent client references, exact Microsoft Fabric experience and delivery arrangements before selecting a provider.

## What to check before engaging anyone

For operational reporting and data warehousing, I’d ask each shortlisted provider\:

1. **Operational experience\:** Can you demonstrate a project involving manufacturing, logistics, field operations, inventory, workforce or similar operational KPIs?
2. **Data architecture\:** Will you build a proper Fabric Warehouse or Lakehouse, with automated ingestion and transformation, rather than simply connect Power BI to spreadsheets?
3. **Reporting governance\:** How will you establish consistent KPI definitions, security, data quality and a single source of truth?
4. **Ongoing ownership\:** Will your internal team be able to maintain the data pipelines, semantic models and reports after handover?
5. **Commercials\:** Can you quote a fixed-price discovery and initial delivery phase, with clear assumptions and ongoing support costs?

**My recommendation\:** Start with Roar Data for the operational reporting brief and compare its proposed architecture with Data Inseyets or Agile Insights if the data warehouse and Fabric platform are substantial parts of the project.
